resolution: An owner call where the print has two readings. Checked 2026-10-10: the scan data/cards/Beyond-Codex-Incarnate.jpg prints the type line "Book Token Unit", as the owner ruling of 2026-08-23 (“TRANSFORM: turning a card over is…”) transcribed it. The owner ruling of 2026-08-25 (“the owner's answers to the 27…”) reads that word as marking a face that never enters a deck (which is how the engine uses it), not as making the card a token, and the owner ruling of 2026-08-25 (“WHEN a transformed card turns back…”) turns the card back over before it leaves play, so it reaches the bin as Scholar of the Void and can be recurred. The rules (concepts.cards.faces.back-not-token, types.tokens.back-face) state the owner ruling of 2026-08-25 (“the owner's answers to the 27…”) with basis owner, for sign-off. A judge who reads the type line literally would make the turned card a token while it is in play (so "nontoken" text would not count it); the bin result is the same either way.

resolution: Answered by the owner on 2026-10-22, reading A: "Resolves first".
